In this update:
- Spark now keeps running in the background after you quit, so your AI agents can still reach it.
- Raycast joins the list of AI agents you can connect. Setup opens the Spark extension for you.
- Auto-Drafts: you can now auto-draft a reply to a specific email in a thread. When you turn on Auto-Drafts in Settings, Spark now asks you to choose a Persona.
- Autopilot has a new step-by-step setup. Choose what you want to automate, then pick a ready-made task or describe your own.
- Fixed an issue where trying to sign in again after an IMAP login error could freeze or crash Spark for Yahoo and AOL accounts.
- Fixed an issue where search indexing kept trying to download a message that failed to load.
We’re always here for you at support@sparkmailapp.com
P.S. If you encounter any issues with the automatic update, please use the following link to download the update manually:
https://downloads.sparkmailapp.com/Spark3/win/dist/3.33.0.141685/Spark.exe

In this update:
- My Writing Style now lives in the new Personalization section in Settings, where you can set your preferred tone and length and manage the sample emails Spark learns from.
- Auto Drafts now includes an option to automatically delete drafts you don’t use.
- Autopilot rules can now run on a repeating schedule and be triggered by dates and times, and each rule now has a quick-actions menu in the rules list.
- Mail syncs faster and more reliably for IMAP accounts: new messages arrive quicker for Yahoo and AOL, and your inbox refreshes as soon as you return to Spark.
- Fixed an issue where Spark could show a “Not sent” notification for an email that was actually sent.
- Fixed an issue where restoring a Gmail message from the Bin could place it in the wrong folder.
- Fixed an issue where accounts that require multi-factor authentication could stop syncing without asking you to sign in again.
- Fixed several smaller issues affecting contacts, the folder picker, and Spark Assistant.
We’re always here for you at support@sparkmailapp.com

P.S. If you encounter any issues with the automatic update, please use the following link to download the update manually:
https://downloads.sparkmailapp.com/Spark3/win/dist/3.32.5.141587/Spark.exe

Introducing Spark Autopilot!
Automate your inbox in plain words. Pick from ready-made suggestions or describe what you want, like "archive my newsletters" or "forward invoices to my accountant," and Spark builds the automation for you.

Before anything goes live, Autopilot shows you exactly which emails it will act on.
Once it's running, you can see what it has handled and pause, edit, or turn it off anytime.
Every edit is re-tested before it's applied, so your automations keep working the way you intended.

Give it a try and share your feedback with us at support@sparkmailapp.com

Agents, meet inbox.
Spark CLI can now triage your inbox — letting AI agents act on emails, not just read them. Ask your agent to draft emails and replies, archive and label emails, and more. You choose the agent. You choose which accounts are shared.
Go to Settings → AI Agents to choose your access level:
- Off— the agent can’t see this account.
- Read-only— search, summarize, and pull context (free).
- Triage— everything in Read-only, plus draft, reply, snooze, pin, label, move, archive, and team comments (Spark Pro).
Read access stays free. Triage is included with Spark Pro.
Curated agent skills — including new ones for inbox triage and morning briefings — live at github.com/readdle/spark-cli-skills.

We’ve redesigned the email layout and shipped several notable improvements across navigation, scheduling, and file sharing.
New additions:

- Find shared availability faster by pasting a list of addresses into Meet With.

- Split View now shows clearer separation between the email list and viewer.
- Mark as Done and Close buttons have more space between them to prevent misclicks.

This update brings changes many of you asked for. Let us know what you think — email support@sparkmailapp.com to share your feedback.

We’ve made lots of improvements and fixes.
- The Undo Send timer: Catch last-minute mistakes before they reach your recipients. Head to Spark Settings > General > Undo Send Timer to give yourself more time to cancel an email send.
- New composer from Drafts: Writing multiple emails at once? Now you can open extra composer windows directly from an existing draft using the same shortcut (Ctrl + Alt + N).
- Rename meeting transcript headers: Keep your meeting notes tidier — open a note and click on its header to replace the auto-generated version with a custom title.
- Delete individual emails from a thread: Click “...” next to any email in a thread to delete it.
- Open transcripts and notes in Calendar: Switch from your Calendar to Meeting Notes in a single click — events with transcripts now include a “Open in Meeting Notes” button.
- Close ‘More’ more easily: Click ‘More’ once to reveal your full folder list. Click it a second time to dismiss the menu.
- "Auto-download attachment" option: Manage your bandwidth and digital safety — choose whether attachments load automatically. Head to Settings > General to switch this on or off.
- More fixes than we can mention here. :)
